description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class 'SlidingTabsColorsFragment' that demonstrates the use of a custom SlidingTabLayout with a ViewPager to display multiple tabs with different colors and titles. It includes inner classes for tab items and a FragmentPagerAdapter to manage tab content.

classes.name: SlidingTabsColorsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment demonstrating a custom sliding tab layout with colored tabs and a ViewPager.

classes.name: SamplePagerItem
classes.description: Inner class representing a tab with title, indicator color, and divider color, capable of creating its associated content fragment.

classes.name: SampleFragmentPagerAdapter
classes.description: Inner class extending FragmentPagerAdapter to supply fragments and titles for each tab.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the list of tabs with titles and colors.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the ViewPager and SlidingTabLayout, including custom colorizer for tabs.
